summary: Olli approved the operational-ledger candidate at H-UI-01 on 28 July 2026 after its contract, data lineage, complete state model, responsive recomposition, keyboard/focus behaviour, accessibility tree and 67/75 Gate B pass were proven. This is an approved foundation direction with no canonical or production authority.

whatWasProven.claim: Visible records and figures are repository-backed rather than invented product data.
whatWasProven.method: verify_product_ui_contract.py reads every named fixture source and cross-checks product registry counts, Figma 24/18/105 totals, component authority and the 5/1/1 status distribution.
whatWasProven.result: PASS; seven unique records and every summary value matched its named source.

whatWasProven.claim: Responsive recomposition preserves every record without page overflow.
whatWasProven.method: In-app browser viewport sweep at 320, 375, 390, 768, 920, 1280 and 1440; measured document scroll width, row count, hidden rows and table display mode after each render.
whatWasProven.result: PASS; zero body overflow, seven of seven records present and zero hidden at every width. Table fields recompose to labelled blocks below 640px; the inspector follows the ledger below 1024px.

whatWasProven.claim: Keyboard and visible-focus behaviour is functional.
whatWasProven.method: Pressed ArrowDown from Ledger in the roving navigation, inspected the resulting tab stops and computed focus style, then opened and closed the command dialog from the keyboard path.
whatWasProven.result: PASS; Registry became the only navigation tab stop, computed focus was a solid 3px ring with 3px offset, modal focus entered search, background became inert/aria-hidden, Escape restored focus to the trigger.

whatWasProven.claim: Filtering, sorting, density, selection and bounded workspace views operate on the same source fixture.
whatWasProven.method: Browser interaction with the live candidate and targeted DOM checks after each action.
whatWasProven.result: PASS; Halftone filter returned one record, name sort set aria-sort=ascending, presentation density retained all fields, record selection updated inspector/current state, and Registry/Components/Release views returned 1/3/1 truthful records.

whatWasProven.claim: All seven named product states preserve explicit meaning.
whatWasProven.method: Selected ready, loading, empty, error, stale, partial and no-permission in the running state lab and read banner, table visibility, row count and live-region output.
whatWasProven.result: PASS; every state produced its named explanation; error and no-permission hid the record table, empty rendered zero rows, and ready restored all records.

whatWasProven.claim: Table and data-view semantics are available to accessibility APIs.
whatWasProven.method: Read the browser accessibility-tree snapshot and implementation-generated labels.
whatWasProven.result: PASS; named landmarks, table caption, row/column structure, buttons, aria-sort, polite live region, chart role label and complete 5-of-7 / 1-of-7 / 1-of-7 text alternative were exposed.

whatWasProven.claim: The visual surface clears Gate B.
whatWasProven.method: Rendered and inspected desktop workspace, ledger/inspector, data view and mobile segments; ran T1–T4 and the anti-slop sweep.
whatWasProven.result: PASS at 67/75 with no blocking findings; recorded in round-01-gate-b.json.

knownGaps: A real VoiceOver or NVDA spoken-output session has not been recorded; current screen-reader evidence is the browser accessibility tree and live-region output.
No real AI OS workflow is represented because production product evidence has not been supplied.
Authentication, persistence, routing, exports, analytics and product-specific business rules remain consumer-owned and untested by this candidate.
humanDecisionsRequired: A later bounded task must identify which real redacted product workflow becomes the first production-evidence test; UI-01 approval does not invent or select that evidence.
